column2: revert ""iwlwifi: save PCI state before suspend

column1: resume"".  That misguided patch led to being unable to use iwlwifi

column2: indicate to PCI driver that the saved PCI state is valid during suspend.

column1: We restore PCI state and enable the device when network interface is created
similarly PCI state is saved and the device is disabled when network interface

column2: when .suspend is called the PCI state is saved and device

column1: is disabled. This is the case even if an interface is never created as PCI
state is saved and device disabled during .probe.
PCI driver assumes PCI state is saved in .suspend. Saving the state at this
time will save state of disabled device and thus cause problems during
resume (resuming a disabled device). We thus indicate directly to PCI
driver that current PCI saved state is valid.
